cards.text: Jeremiah the prophet is in Jerusalem, writing a letter. It's going to the exiles Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, carried off from Jerusalem to Babylon. That's the surviving elders, the priests, the prophets and everyone else.

cards.question: Before Jeremiah's letter, Jeconiah, king of Judah, had already been carried off from Jerusalem too.

cards.text: Two men are headed to King Nebuchadnezzar in Babylon, and Jeremiah's letter rides along with them: Elasah son of Shaphan and Gemariah son of Hilkiah.

cards.question: Elasah and Gemariah are carrying Jeremiah's letter to Babylon. Who sent them to King Nebuchadnezzar?
Jeremiah's letter to the exiles opens by saying whose words these are. Whose are they?
The LORD tells the exiles in Babylon to keep their bags packed and get ready to leave.

cards.text: Build houses, settle down, plant gardens and eat their produce. Friend, that's not "hang tight," that's "CHANGE YOUR MAILING ADDRESS."

cards.question: The LORD tells the exiles not to marry or have children while they're in Babylon.

cards.text: Marry, have sons and daughters, and marry off those sons and daughters so they have children too: "Multiply there; do not decrease." Then the LORD turns to the city they're living in.

cards.question: The LORD tells the exiles to seek the ___ of the city He has sent them to as exiles.
The LORD also tells the exiles to pray to Him for that city. Why?

answers.text: Because if it prospers they will too
Because its king will set them free
Because its people will join them

cards.text: Then the letter turns to the prophets and diviners right there among the exiles. People have been drawing dreams out of them.

cards.question: The LORD tells the exiles to listen closely to the dreams they get from those prophets and diviners.
The prophets among the exiles are prophesying in the LORD's name. What does the LORD say about them?

answers.text: He sent them to test His people
They will be proven right later

cards.text: Then the LORD gives the exiles a number: Babylon gets seventy years. Seventy years… okay, I'm gonna need a BIGGER calendar.

cards.question: When Babylon's seventy years are complete, the LORD promises to restore the exiles to ___.
The LORD says He knows the plans He has for the exiles. What are those plans meant to do?

answers.text: Prosper them and not harm them

cards.text: And the LORD isn't done with that sentence. Those plans are "to give you a future and a hope." A future AND a hope, friend, in a letter sent to people in exile.

cards.question: The LORD says the exiles will call upon Him and pray to Him, and He will listen to them.
The LORD says the exiles will seek Him and find Him. When will they find Him?

answers.text: When they search with all their heart
When a new prophet shows up

cards.text: Then the LORD says, "I will be found by you…" Friend, coming from the One who found ME in the back of a junk drawer, I believe it.

cards.question: The LORD promises to gather the exiles from all the nations and places He banished them to.

cards.text: And that's where we'll set this letter down for now. Don't go anywhere, friend, because Jeremiah's not done writing.
